name: Glass Heart
source:
Meira (protagonist), the Glass Hearted Girl, has lived her life in hospital rooms. Years of fighting to survive has resulted in a bittersweet outcome. The surgery that could save her life only has a 20% chance of success. Failure means death. With one month until the operation, the Glass Hearted Girl sets out to experience something worth living for. Will she find the strength to survive or will her heart shatter?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2223020/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
有着“玻璃之心”的女孩Meira——本作主角——一直生活在病房里。多年求生，终于迎来一个喜忧参半的结果：能够挽救她生命的手术，成功率只有20%。失败，就意味着死亡。距离手术还有一个月，玻璃心女孩决定去体验一些值得为之活下去的事物。她能找到活下去的力量，还是会就此心碎？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2223020/]Steam[/url]]
